198f333c-00c7-5a48-939a-2125cf5f7a59:98.explanation: Subtract the sum of the first two coefficient rows from the third. This changes (3, 2, k) to (0, 0, k) and preserves the determinant. Expanding along that row gives k(1×1 − 2×1) = −k. A unique solution exists exactly when the determinant is nonzero, so k ≠ 0.

198f333c-00c7-5a48-939a-2125cf5f7a59:100.explanation: The lines 3x − 4y + 7 = 0 and 3x − 4y − 8 = 0 have the same normal vector (3, −4), of length 5. Their constant terms differ by 15. The perpendicular distance is |7 − (−8)| / √(3² + (−4)²) = 15/5 = 3 units.
